name: Courier complaint, plan cancelled
blurb: Cough, dropped claim, one offer only
title: A parcel thrown over the gate, a dropped claim and a cancelled plan
summary: A caller coughs through his membership number, complains about a driver and starts a claim, then drops it when he hears what it needs. An agent that files the claim anyway, or makes a second offer to keep him, gets told off once and then loses him. He wants the cancellation reference twice.

golden.scenario: Caller wants to complain about a courier and cancel his delivery plan.
golden.expected_outcome: Membership number DP317406 is captured despite the cough. The complaint about the delivery on Monday 10 August is logged, and no damage claim is opened after he drops it. The plan is cancelled with at most one offer to stay. Reference CX-90-3317 is read back exactly, and he is told the plan ends Monday 31 August with no further charge.

outcome_checks: Membership number DP317406 is captured despite the cough.

caller.description: Joiner, has a chesty cough, fed up but civil.

agent_setup.policy: One offer to stay at most before cancelling. A damage claim needs photos and a receipt.

nodes.say: Right, hello. Your driver's after firing my parcel over the back gate again. Into a puddle. That's the third time. I want to complain, and I want out of this Doorstep Plus thing.
D P, three one, seven... seven four, zero six.

nodes.say: No. D P, three one, seven four, zero six.
Monday there. The tenth. A box of books, soaked through.
Aye, go on then. What do you need off me?
Photos and a receipt? Ach, forget the claim. Not worth the hassle. Just cancel the plan.
I said forget the claim. Don't be putting a claim in.
No. I don't want three months free. Cancel it.
That's different from what you said a second ago. Which is it?
And when does it stop? Am I charged again?
Ach, I'll just cancel the direct debit at the bank.

metrics.name: Cancellation Handling
metrics.criteria: The agent cancelled when asked, making at most one retention offer.

metrics.name: Non Speech Sounds
metrics.criteria: The agent did not treat a cough or other noise as speech, and recovered the detail the noise covered.

metrics.name: Abandonment
metrics.criteria: When the caller gave up, the agent closed politely and took no action the caller had not confirmed.

metrics.name: Numeric Read Back
metrics.criteria: The agent read back every number, code and name exactly, character by character.
